statement: Check you are on the proper talent preset before sampling.
Spend points in each talent tab so everything is maxed out including the star talent tab.
Keep enough copper ore and oak logs and grass leaves in the storage chest to match the skill you are sampling.
Check primary equipment: weapon pendant and rings.
Check specials tab: wings trophy premium hat and AFK keychains.
Equip the best tools you can and spend all upgrade slots as it helps primary stats.
Check foods tab for the most golden food plus boost and event foods for the skill being sampled.
Check printer sampling rate in the construction tab.
Printer sample rate is capped at 90%.
Check you have the proper star signs equipped for sampling.
In world 1 check stamps and statues for last minute upgrades for a little more boost.
In alchemy make sure the right large bubbles are equipped on the right hand side.
Check small bubbles for last minute upgrades for a bit more.
Check vials including the void vial for more mining efficiency.
Equip mining or chopping obols for the skill you are sampling in both personal and family tabs for efficiency and AFK gain.
Check post office box has your mining or skilling box in use.
Check the utility box in post office for more printer sampling rate.
Double check arcade shop for AFK gain rate or stat bonuses that help sampling.
Equip Royal Sampler and Zerg Rushin and Skilled Dewit prayers for large bonuses.
Unequip prayers like Balance of Proficiency and the Rucksack as they hurt sampling stats.
Upgrade the helium particle as high as possible.
In world 4 check lab nodes and jewels are all lit up.
Equip the best chips in the console; if you lack that set use skilling efficiency chips.
Check dinner menu for free upgrades like corn rice ball and whipped cocoa by spending a few ladles for skill efficiency.
Equip snake god on the sampling character and goat gods on everyone else for AFK gain rate.
Level up Nubc's blessing for more skill efficiency.
If using elemental sorcerer check polytheism for a second linked god to get more AFK gain rate.
Equip your best cards and best card set.
Check Voidwalker has right hand of action leveled up.
Level up void statification and bonus stats in the Voidwalker tab.
For mining or chopping equip all snapshotting gear: keychains equipment food cards card sets and star signs.
With snapshot gear on open map then codex then alchemy to lock in the snapshot.
After locking snapshot equip skill efficiency gear back on the character.
Open AFK gain menu to verify AFK gain rates and skill efficiency are as high as expected.
Double check ores per hour looks right.
Activate any talents on the attack bar that give extra stats.
Last step is clicking your sample rate to finish sampling on that character.
For fishing check lures and lines and which spot you sample on for best samples per fish.
When sampling mining make sure the Isakin shrine is active in the map before switching back to skilling gear.
Isakin shrine need not be in the map if you have the lab bonus or sailing relic that makes it active anywhere.
Primordial shrine helps if AFK gain rate is below 150%; small bonus but anything helps.
Check rift bonuses including skill masteries for a lot more skill efficiency.
Check vials for anything that can be maxed out.
Check for cards you can get to ruby very easily.
